title: Range Four Harry on scout craft and the speed of light
summary: Charles Hall tells of Range Four Harry on scout craft and the speed of light, about 1965-1967 at Indian Springs Valley, Nevada, and relays what a named person told them. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: ellipsoidal. One time I asked personally asked range for Harry if that craft could exceed the speed of light. He was a very nice guy. We were like brothers. He was very adamant. He said it could, but nobody, I'm going to use my words in their right mind would ever take it that fast.

plain: Charles Hall, a man who says he spent three years in the mid 1960s on Air Force ranges near Indian Springs Valley, Nevada, living alongside tall white aliens, told a podcast host, Jesse Michels, about a man he calls Range Four Harry, whom he says he was close to "like brothers." Hall says he once asked Harry whether one of the egg-shaped scout craft there could go faster than light, and Harry firmly said it could, though no one in their right mind would ever take it that fast. If true, it would mean these craft could break what we think is the universe's speed limit.
